cli.usage.text.en:
kura — a manager for agent skills (headless command line)

Usage:
  kura <command> [args] [flags]

Commands:
  list                 List all skills (enabled + disabled + trashed)
  scan                 Same as list (alias; handy with --root to override the root)
  disable <NAME>       Disable a skill (move it to <home>/disabled/, a pure move)
  enable <NAME>        Enable a skill (move it back from disabled/ to the root)
  remove <NAME> [--stamp TS]
                       Move to the trash (snapshot first); --stamp names the
                       trash timestamp folder
  restore <NAME> [--stamp TS]
                       Restore from the trash; --stamp defaults to the newest
  import-meta [--dry-run] [--lock PATH]
                       Fill in missing .kura-meta.json from the
                       .skill-lock.json next to the root; --dry-run only
                       reports, it writes nothing; default folder only, added
                       folders are rejected (exit 1)
  add --local PATH [--name N]
                       Install a skill from a local folder
  add --github owner/repo [--sub-path P] [--ref R] [--name N]
                       Install a skill from a GitHub repository; without
                       --sub-path the skills inside are discovered: a single
                       candidate installs directly, several candidates are
                       listed and fail with exit 1, pick one with --sub-path
  update <NAME>        Pull the recorded source again and replace the content
                       (snapshot first)
  update --check <NAME>
                       Preview what updating NAME would change (writes nothing);
                       exit 3 when an update is pending, 0 when up to date
  update --check --all
                       Preview every skill in the root (one block per skill)
  doctor               Read-only check: missing metadata / corrupt metadata /
                       content drift / missing SKILL.md / leftovers in disabled
                       and trash
  version              Print the version

Global flags (may follow any subcommand):
  --json        Output JSON; on errors the message goes to stderr as {"error": "..."}
  --root PATH   Skills root folder (default $KURA_ROOT or ~/.agents/skills)
  --home PATH   kura data folder (default $KURA_HOME or ~/.kura)
  --lang LANG   Interface language: system | zh | en (default $KURA_LANG, then
                config.json, then the system locale)

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  operation failed (skill not found, name conflict, I/O error, ...)
  2  usage error (unknown command, bad flag, wrong number of arguments)
  3  doctor found problems (see its output)

JSON shapes (with --json):
  list/scan   {"root": string, "skills": [{name, state, hasSkillMd, dir,
              sourceType?, sourceURL?, ref?, subPath?, pluginName?,
              updatedAt?, metaError?}]}
  changes     {"id": string, "state": string, "dir": string,
              "snapshotDir"?: string}
  doctor      {"root": string, "problems": [{kind, skill, detail}]}
              kind in not-a-dir | no-meta | meta-parse | hash-drift |
                      no-skillmd | leftover
  import-meta {"root": string, "lockPath": string, "dryRun": bool,
              "wouldImport"?: [string], "imported"?: [string]}
  add (many candidates) {"error": string, "repo": string,
              "candidates": [string]} (stderr, exit 1)
  update --check NAME
              {"skill": string, "sourceType": string, "commit"?: string,
              "hasChanges": bool, "basis": string, "localModified": bool,
              "oldHash": string, "newHash": string,
              "files": [{path, status, added, removed, oldHash?, newHash?}],
              "unchanged": int}
              status in added | changed | removed; files holds only the
              differing files, [] when there is nothing to do. Exit code: 3
              when an update is pending, 0 when up to date.
              basis in commit | tree | content: git sources compare the upstream
              commit with git ls-remote (commit), when it changed the tree hash
              of the skill folder (tree); neither downloads files, anything else
              compares file by file (content). localModified true means the
              installed content was edited (an unchanged upstream is not an
              update, but applying one overwrites those edits).
  update --check --all
              {"root": string,
              "results": [{skill, error?, check?}]}
              check has the shape above; exit 3 if any skill has an update.
              Skills from the same repository share one check and clone.
cli.usage.text.zh:
kura —— agent skills 管理器（无界面命令行）

用法:
  kura <命令> [参数] [flags]

命令:
  list                 列出全部技能（enabled + disabled + trashed）
  scan                 同 list（别名，习惯上配合 --root 覆盖根目录）
  disable <NAME>       禁用技能（移动到 <home>/disabled/，纯移动）
  enable <NAME>        启用技能（从 disabled/ 移回根目录）
  remove <NAME> [--stamp TS]
                       移入回收站（先写快照）；--stamp 指定回收站时间戳目录名
  restore <NAME> [--stamp TS]
                       从回收站恢复；--stamp 省略时取最新一次
  import-meta [--dry-run] [--lock PATH]
                       依据根目录同级的 .skill-lock.json 补写缺失的
                       .kura-meta.json；--dry-run 只分析不写文件；
                       只适用于默认目录，界面里追加的目录会被拒绝（退出码 1）
  add --local PATH [--name N]
                       从本地目录安装技能
  add --github owner/repo [--sub-path P] [--ref R] [--name N]
                       从 GitHub 仓库安装技能；不给 --sub-path 时自动发现
                       仓库内的技能：唯一候选直接安装，多个候选列出清单
                       并以退出码 1 失败，请用 --sub-path 指定其中一个
  update <NAME>        按元数据记录的来源重新拉取并替换内容（先快照）
  update --check <NAME>
                       预览 NAME 的更新会改什么（不修改任何文件）；
                       有待更新退出码 3，无变化退出码 0
  update --check --all
                       预览根目录全部技能的更新（每个技能一段结果）
  doctor               只读体检：缺元数据 / 元数据损坏 / 内容漂移 /
                       缺 SKILL.md / disabled 与 trash 中的残留条目
  version              打印版本

全局 flags（可写在任何子命令之后）:
  --json        输出 JSON；出错时错误信息以 {"error": "..."} 输出到 stderr
  --root PATH   技能根目录（默认 $KURA_ROOT 或 ~/.agents/skills）
  --home PATH   kura 数据目录（默认 $KURA_HOME 或 ~/.kura）
  --lang LANG   界面语言：system | zh | en（默认 $KURA_LANG，其次
                config.json 的 lang，最后跟随系统）

退出码:
  0  成功
  1  操作失败（技能不存在、同名冲突、IO 错误等）
  2  用法错误（未知命令、flag 解析失败、参数个数不对）
  3  doctor 发现问题（明细见其输出）

JSON 输出形状（--json 时）:
  list/scan   {"root": string, "skills": [{name, state, hasSkillMd, dir,
              sourceType?, sourceURL?, ref?, subPath?, pluginName?,
              updatedAt?, metaError?}]}
  变更命令     {"id": string, "state": string, "dir": string,
              "snapshotDir"?: string}
  doctor      {"root": string, "problems": [{kind, skill, detail}]}
              kind ∈ not-a-dir | no-meta | meta-parse | hash-drift |
                      no-skillmd | leftover
  import-meta {"root": string, "lockPath": string, "dryRun": bool,
              "wouldImport"?: [string], "imported"?: [string]}
  add（多候选） {"error": string, "repo": string,
              "candidates": [string]}（输出到 stderr，退出码 1）
  update --check NAME
              {"skill": string, "sourceType": string, "commit"?: string,
              "hasChanges": bool, "basis": string, "localModified": bool,
              "oldHash": string, "newHash": string,
              "files": [{path, status, added, removed, oldHash?, newHash?}],
              "unchanged": int}
              status ∈ added | changed | removed；files 只含差异文件，
              无变化时为 []。退出码：有待更新 3，无变化 0。
              basis ∈ commit | tree | content：git 来源先用 git ls-remote
              比对上游 commit（commit），commit 变了再比对该技能目录的树哈希
              （tree），这两种都不下载文件；其余情况才逐文件比较（content）。
              localModified 为 true 表示已安装内容被改过（上游没变时不算
              有更新，但应用更新会覆盖这些改动）。
  update --check --all
              {"root": string,
              "results": [{skill, error?, check?}]}
              check 的形状同上；任一技能有待更新退出码 3。同一仓库的技能
              共用一次检查与 clone。

store.err.sourceNoSkillMD.zh: store: 来源目录缺少 SKILL.md: %s

store.err.sourceNotDir.en: store: the source is not a folder: %s

store.err.sourceUnreadable.en: store: the source folder is not readable

store.err.sparseCheckout.en: store: failed to set up the sparse checkout
store.err.sparseCheckout.zh: store: 准备稀疏检出失败

store.err.tempDir.en: store: failed to create a temp folder
store.err.tempDir.zh: store: 创建临时目录失败

store.err.tooManyCandidates.en: store: the repository %s holds %d skills; pick one with --sub-path:
store.err.tooManyCandidates.zh: store: 仓库 %s 里有 %d 个技能，请用 --sub-path 指定其中一个：

store.err.tooManySkills.en: store: too many skill candidates in the repository
store.err.tooManySkills.zh: store: 仓库内技能候选过多

store.err.tooManySkillsLimit.en: store: too many skill candidates in the repository (limit %d)
store.err.tooManySkillsLimit.zh: store: 仓库内技能候选过多（上限 %d 个）

store.err.translateEmpty.en: store: the translation response is empty
store.err.translateEmpty.zh: store: 翻译响应内容为空

store.err.translateEndpoint.zh: store: 构造翻译请求失败（请检查 API 地址 %s）

store.err.translateNoChoices.en: store: the translation response has no choices (the server returned no translation)
store.err.translateNoChoices.zh: store: 翻译响应里没有 choices（服务端未返回译文）

store.err.translateParse.en: store: failed to parse the translation response (not valid JSON)
store.err.translateParse.zh: store: 解析翻译响应失败（不是合法 JSON）

store.err.translateRead.en: store: failed to read the translation response
store.err.translateRead.zh: store: 读取翻译响应失败

store.err.translateRequest.en: store: failed to build the translation request
store.err.translateRequest.zh: store: 构造翻译请求失败

store.err.trashRead.en: store: failed to read %s from the trash
store.err.trashRead.zh: store: 读取回收站中的 %s 失败

store.err.unknownRoot.en: store: that folder is not in the list
store.err.unknownRoot.zh: store: 列表中没有该目录

store.err.unknownSkillInTrash.en: store: skill not found: %s (not in the trash)
store.err.unknownSkillInTrash.zh: store: 未找到该技能: %s（回收站中不存在）

store.err.unknownTheme.en: store: the theme must be system, light or dark
store.err.unknownTheme.zh: store: 外观只能是 system、light 或 dark

store.err.unknownUILang.en: store: the UI language must be system, zh or en
store.err.unknownUILang.zh: store: 界面语言只能是 system、zh 或 en

store.err.unknownView.en: store: the view must be grid or list
store.err.unknownView.zh: store: 排列模式只能是 grid 或 list

store.err.updateMeta.en: store: failed to update the metadata

store.err.userHome.en: store: cannot locate the user home folder
store.err.userHome.zh: store: 无法确定用户主目录

ui.action.purgeTooltip.zh: 永久删除回收站里的技能

ui.action.removeRoot.en: Remove this directory from the list

ui.confirm.purgeMessage.en: Skill %s will be deleted from the trash permanently and cannot be restored. A content snapshot is written first and kept in the kura data directory.
ui.confirm.purgeMessage.zh: 技能 %s 将从回收站永久删除，无法恢复。删除前会先写入一份内容快照，快照保留在 kura 的数据目录里。

ui.confirm.trashMessage.en: Skill %s will be moved from the skill directory to the kura trash and can be restored at any time. A content snapshot is written before the move.
ui.confirm.trashMessage.zh: 技能 %s 将从技能目录移入 kura 回收站，可随时恢复；移动前会自动写入内容快照。

ui.detail.noMeta.en: No .kura-meta.json (not installed by kura, or the metadata was never imported)
ui.detail.noMeta.zh: 没有 .kura-meta.json（非 kura 安装，或尚未导入元数据）

ui.empty.noSkills.en: No skills in this directory yet
ui.empty.noSkills.zh: 这个目录里还没有技能

ui.empty.noSkillsHint.en: Click “Install skill” at the top right to install from GitHub or a local folder
ui.empty.noSkillsHint.zh: 点右上角的「安装技能」，从 GitHub 或本地文件夹安装

ui.install.folderPlaceholder.zh: 包含 SKILL.md 的文件夹

ui.install.hintCandidates.en: Select the skills to install (multiple allowed) and use the button below to install them at once; each name comes from its own SKILL.md (when you select one, the “Install name” above is used).
ui.install.hintCandidates.zh: 勾选要安装的技能（可多选），点下面的按钮一次装完；名字取各自 SKILL.md 里的 name（勾选一个时用上面的「安装名称」）。

ui.install.hintGitHub.en: Clones the repository with your local git; when the subdirectory is empty, skills in the repository are discovered automatically.
ui.install.hintGitHub.zh: 会用本机的 git 克隆仓库；子目录留空时自动发现仓库里的技能。

ui.install.namePlaceholder.en: Optional; defaults to the name in SKILL.md
ui.install.namePlaceholder.zh: 可选，默认取 SKILL.md 的 name

ui.install.noCandidates.en: store: no skill directory containing SKILL.md was found in the repository
ui.install.noCandidates.zh: store: 仓库内未找到含 SKILL.md 的技能目录

ui.install.repoOrBranchChanged.en: The repository or branch changed; click “Install” to discover skills again.
ui.install.repoOrBranchChanged.zh: 仓库或分支已改，点「安装」重新发现技能。

ui.install.repoPlaceholder.en: owner/repo, or paste a GitHub URL

ui.install.subPathPlaceholder.en: Optional; leave empty to discover automatically

ui.panic.iconDecode.en: ui: could not decode the app icon: %s
ui.panic.iconDecode.zh: ui: 应用图标解码失败: %s

ui.rail.checkUpdateTip.zh: 检查 kura 应用更新

ui.rail.settingsTip.zh: 翻译 API 与目标语言

ui.review.localModified.en: The installed content differs from what was installed (modified locally)
ui.review.localModified.zh: 已安装的内容与安装时不一致（本地改过）

ui.review.localModifiedWithChanges.en: The installed content differs from what was installed (modified locally), and applying the update will overwrite these changes (old contents are in a snapshot)
ui.review.localModifiedWithChanges.zh: 已安装的内容与安装时不一致（本地改过），应用更新会覆盖这些改动（旧内容在快照中）

ui.review.noResult.zh: 没有可显示的检查结果

ui.review.nothingToCheck.en: No skills to check in this directory
ui.review.nothingToCheck.zh: 根目录里没有可检查的技能

ui.roots.loadFailed.en: Could not read the directory list: %s

ui.settings.incomplete.en: Fill in the API URL, the key and the model to translate skill descriptions.
ui.settings.incomplete.zh: API 地址、密钥、模型都填好后，才能翻译技能描述。

ui.settings.loadFailed.en: Could not read the settings file; saving will overwrite it: %s
ui.settings.loadFailed.zh: 设置文件读取失败，保存会覆盖它：%s

ui.settings.secretNote.en: The key is stored in plain text at ~/.kura/settings.json. Translations are shown in the interface only; skill files are never modified.
ui.settings.secretNote.zh: 密钥以明文保存在 ~/.kura/settings.json；译文只用于界面显示，不会改动技能文件。

ui.settings.unknownTargetLang.en: The saved target language was not recognized; reset to %s. Save to apply.
ui.settings.unknownTargetLang.zh: 已保存的目标语言无法识别，已回到%s；保存后生效。

ui.status.appUpdateChecking.zh: 正在检查 kura 更新…

ui.status.appUpdateNotReady.en: Updates are not available (this development build has no update plugin)
ui.status.appUpdateNotReady.zh: 更新功能未就绪（开发构建未挂载更新插件）

ui.status.candidates.en: The repository has %d skills; select the ones to install
ui.status.candidates.zh: 仓库里有 %d 个技能，请勾选要安装的

ui.status.checkSummary.zh: %s: 新增 %d · 修改 %d · 删除 %d（共 %d 个文件）

ui.status.discoverRootsFailed.en: Could not discover agent skill directories: %s
ui.status.discoverRootsFailed.zh: 自动发现技能目录失败：%s

ui.status.discovering.en: Looking for skills in the repository…
ui.status.discovering.zh: 正在查找仓库里的技能…

ui.status.installedPartial.zh: 已安装 %d 个，%d 个失败

ui.status.langSaveFailed.en: Could not save the interface language: %s

ui.status.nothingToImport.en: Nothing to import (no lock file, or every skill already has metadata)
ui.status.nothingToImport.zh: 没有可导入的元数据（lock 文件不存在或技能已有元数据）

ui.status.repoChanged.en: The repository or branch changed; click “Install” to discover skills again.
ui.status.repoChanged.zh: 仓库或分支已改，点「安装」重新发现技能。

ui.status.rootMissing.en: The skill directory does not exist: %s

ui.status.rootRemoved.en: Removed %s from the list (the folder is untouched)
ui.status.rootRemoved.zh: 已从列表移除 %s（文件夹未改动）

ui.status.rootsDiscovered.zh: 已自动加入 %d 个 agent 技能目录

ui.status.settingsSavedShort.en: Settings saved, but the translation API is incomplete, so translation is unavailable for now
ui.status.settingsSavedShort.zh: 设置已保存，但翻译 API 还没填全，暂时不能翻译

ui.status.subPathFilled.en: The subdirectory is filled in; click “Install” to install it
ui.status.subPathFilled.zh: 已填子目录，点「安装」装它

ui.status.themeSaveFailed.en: Could not save the appearance preference: %s

ui.status.updated.zh: 已更新 %d 个技能（旧内容在快照中）

ui.status.updatedPartial.zh: 已更新 %d 个技能，%d 个失败: %v

ui.status.viewSaveFailed.en: Could not save the layout mode: %s

ui.translate.chunkEmpty.zh: 第 %d/%d 段：翻译结果为空

ui.translate.failed.en: Translation failed: %s (switch back to Original and then to Translated to retry)
ui.translate.failed.zh: 翻译失败：%s（切回原文再切到译文可重试）

ui.translate.fullFailed.en: Full-text translation failed: %s (switch back to Original and then to Translated to retry)
ui.translate.fullFailed.zh: 全文翻译失败：%s（切回原文再切到译文可重试）

ui.translate.notConfigured.en: Set up the translation API in Settings first
ui.translate.notConfigured.zh: 先在设置里填翻译 API

ui.translate.note.en: Translated · %s · shown in the interface only; skill files are not modified
ui.translate.note.zh: 译文 · %s · 仅界面显示，不改动技能文件
